entities.summary: Uroš Plavšić is a Serbian professional basketball player for Bandırma Bordo of the Türkiye Basketbol Ligi (TBL), on loan from Crvena zvezda. He also represents the Serbian national team. He played college basketball for the Tennessee Volunteers.
